message.content: {"caption":"Stacked-bar comparison of Before RL, PPO, and GRPO scores across three metrics for two models.","description":"Two side-by-side stacked bar charts show Score in % for F1, B1, and J. The left panel is Llama3.1-8B-Instruct and the right panel is GPT-4o-mini. In each bar, blue (Before RL) is the bottom segment, red (PPO) is stacked above it, and green (GRPO) is the top segment. The y-axis has visible ticks from 20 to 80. Values in the chart data are estimated readings at each segment’s top edge, so they are cumulative stack levels, not the individual segment’s contribution. Across both models, J is higher than F1 and B1; GPT-4o-mini has higher totals than Llama3.1-8B-Instruct for all three categories.
